005package org.wpilib.math.geometry;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Meters;
008
009import java.util.Objects;
010import org.wpilib.math.geometry.proto.Transform3dProto;
011import org.wpilib.math.geometry.struct.Transform3dStruct;
012import org.wpilib.math.jni.Transform3dJNI;
013import org.wpilib.math.linalg.MatBuilder;
014import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
015import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N4;
016import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
017import org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance;
018import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable;
019import org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable;
020
021/**
022 * Represents a transformation for a Pose3d in the pose's frame. Translation is applied before
023 * rotation. (The translation is applied in the pose's original frame, not the transformed frame.)
024 *
025 * <p>Transforms are applied intrinsically, i.e. relative to the pose's own frame rather than the
026 * global frame. This is in contrast to the rotation classes, which apply rotations extrinsically.
027 */
028public final class Transform3d implements ProtobufSerializable, StructSerializable {
029  /**
030   * A preallocated Transform3d representing no transformation.
031   *
032   * <p>This exists to avoid allocations for common transformations.
033   */
034  public static final Transform3d ZERO = new Transform3d();
035
036  private final Translation3d m_translation;
037  private final Rotation3d m_rotation;
038
039  /**
040   * Constructs the transform that maps the initial pose to the final pose.
041   *
042   * @param initial The initial pose for the transformation.
043   * @param last The final pose for the transformation.
044   */
045  public Transform3d(Pose3d initial, Pose3d last) {
046    // To transform the global translation delta to be relative to the initial
047    // pose, rotate by the inverse of the initial pose's orientation.
048    m_translation =
049        last.getTranslation()
050            .minus(initial.getTranslation())
051            .rotateBy(initial.getRotation().inverse());
052
053    m_rotation = last.getRotation().relativeTo(initial.getRotation());
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Constructs a transform with the given translation and rotation components.
058   *
059   * @param translation Translational component of the transform.
060   * @param rotation Rotational component of the transform.
061   */
062  public Transform3d(Translation3d translation, Rotation3d rotation) {
063    m_translation = translation;
064    m_rotation = rotation;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Constructs a transform with x, y, and z translations instead of a separate Translation3d.
069   *
070   * @param x The x component of the translational component of the transform.
071   * @param y The y component of the translational component of the transform.
072   * @param z The z component of the translational component of the transform.
073   * @param rotation The rotational component of the transform.
074   */
075  public Transform3d(double x, double y, double z, Rotation3d rotation) {
076    m_translation = new Translation3d(x, y, z);
077    m_rotation = rotation;
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Constructs a transform with x, y, and z translations instead of a separate Translation3d. The
082   * X, Y, and Z translations will be converted to and tracked as meters.
083   *
084   * @param x The x component of the translational component of the transform.
085   * @param y The y component of the translational component of the transform.
086   * @param z The z component of the translational component of the transform.
087   * @param rotation The rotational component of the transform.
088   */
089  public Transform3d(Distance x, Distance y, Distance z, Rotation3d rotation) {
090    this(x.in(Meters), y.in(Meters), z.in(Meters), rotation);
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Constructs a transform with the specified affine transformation matrix.
095   *
096   * @param matrix The affine transformation matrix.
097   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the affine transformation matrix is invalid.
098   */
099  public Transform3d(Matrix<N4, N4> matrix) {
100    m_translation = new Translation3d(matrix.get(0, 3), matrix.get(1, 3), matrix.get(2, 3));
101    m_rotation = new Rotation3d(matrix.block(3, 3, 0, 0));
102    if (matrix.get(3, 0) != 0.0
103        || matrix.get(3, 1) != 0.0
104        || matrix.get(3, 2) != 0.0
105        || matrix.get(3, 3) != 1.0) {
106      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Affine transformation matrix is invalid");
107    }
108  }
109
110  /** Constructs the identity transform -- maps an initial pose to itself. */
111  public Transform3d() {
112    m_translation = Translation3d.ZERO;
113    m_rotation = Rotation3d.ZERO;
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Constructs a 3D transform from a 2D transform in the X-Y plane.
118   *
119   * @param transform The 2D transform.
120   * @see Rotation3d#Rotation3d(Rotation2d)
121   * @see Translation3d#Translation3d(Translation2d)
122   */
123  public Transform3d(Transform2d transform) {
124    m_translation = new Translation3d(transform.getTranslation());
125    m_rotation = new Rotation3d(transform.getRotation());
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Multiplies the transform by the scalar.
130   *
131   * @param scalar The scalar.
132   * @return The scaled Transform3d.
133   */
134  public Transform3d times(double scalar) {
135    return new Transform3d(m_translation.times(scalar), m_rotation.times(scalar));
136  }
137
138  /**
139   * Divides the transform by the scalar.
140   *
141   * @param scalar The scalar.
142   * @return The scaled Transform3d.
143   */
144  public Transform3d div(double scalar) {
145    return times(1.0 / scalar);
146  }
147
148  /**
149   * Composes two transformations. The second transform is applied relative to the orientation of
150   * the first.
151   *
152   * @param other The transform to compose with this one.
153   * @return The composition of the two transformations.
154   */
155  public Transform3d plus(Transform3d other) {
156    return new Transform3d(Pose3d.ZERO, Pose3d.ZERO.transformBy(this).transformBy(other));
157  }
158
159  /**
160   * Returns the translation component of the transformation.
161   *
162   * @return The translational component of the transform.
163   */
164  public Translation3d getTranslation() {
165    return m_translation;
166  }
167
168  /**
169   * Returns the X component of the transformation's translation.
170   *
171   * @return The x component of the transformation's translation.
172   */
173  public double getX() {
174    return m_translation.getX();
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Returns the Y component of the transformation's translation.
179   *
180   * @return The y component of the transformation's translation.
181   */
182  public double getY() {
183    return m_translation.getY();
184  }
185
186  /**
187   * Returns the Z component of the transformation's translation.
188   *
189   * @return The z component of the transformation's translation.
190   */
191  public double getZ() {
192    return m_translation.getZ();
193  }
194
195  /**
196   * Returns the X component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
197   *
198   * @return The x component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
199   */
200  public Distance getMeasureX() {
201    return m_translation.getMeasureX();
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Returns the Y component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
206   *
207   * @return The y component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
208   */
209  public Distance getMeasureY() {
210    return m_translation.getMeasureY();
211  }
212
213  /**
214   * Returns the Z component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
215   *
216   * @return The z component of the transformation's translation in a measure.
217   */
218  public Distance getMeasureZ() {
219    return m_translation.getMeasureZ();
220  }
221
222  /**
223   * Returns an affine transformation matrix representation of this transformation.
224   *
225   * @return An affine transformation matrix representation of this transformation.
226   */
227  public Matrix<N4, N4> toMatrix() {
228    var vec = m_translation.toVector();
229    var mat = m_rotation.toMatrix();
230    return MatBuilder.fill(
231        Nat.N4(),
232        Nat.N4(),
233        mat.get(0, 0),
234        mat.get(0, 1),
235        mat.get(0, 2),
236        vec.get(0),
237        mat.get(1, 0),
238        mat.get(1, 1),
239        mat.get(1, 2),
240        vec.get(1),
241        mat.get(2, 0),
242        mat.get(2, 1),
243        mat.get(2, 2),
244        vec.get(2),
245        0.0,
246        0.0,
247        0.0,
248        1.0);
249  }
250
251  /**
252   * Returns the rotational component of the transformation.
253   *
254   * @return Reference to the rotational component of the transform.
255   */
256  public Rotation3d getRotation() {
257    return m_rotation;
258  }
259
260  /**
261   * Returns a Twist3d of the current transform (pose delta). If b is the output of {@code a.log()},
262   * then {@code b.exp()} would yield a.
263   *
264   * @return The twist that maps the current transform.
265   */
266  public Twist3d log() {
267    var thisQuaternion = m_rotation.getQuaternion();
268    double[] resultArray =
269        Transform3dJNI.log(
270            this.getX(),
271            this.getY(),
272            this.getZ(),
273            thisQuaternion.getW(),
274            thisQuaternion.getX(),
275            thisQuaternion.getY(),
276            thisQuaternion.getZ());
277    return new Twist3d(
278        resultArray[0],
279        resultArray[1],
280        resultArray[2],
281        resultArray[3],
282        resultArray[4],
283        resultArray[5]);
284  }
285
286  /**
287   * Invert the transformation. This is useful for undoing a transformation.
288   *
289   * @return The inverted transformation.
290   */
291  public Transform3d inverse() {
292    // We are rotating the difference between the translations
293    // using a clockwise rotation matrix. This transforms the global
294    // delta into a local delta (relative to the initial pose).
295    return new Transform3d(
296        getTranslation().unaryMinus().rotateBy(getRotation().inverse()), getRotation().inverse());
297  }
298
299  @Override
300  public String toString() {
301    return String.format("Transform3d(%s, %s)", m_translation, m_rotation);
302  }
303
304  /**
305   * Checks equality between this Transform3d and another object.
306   *
307   * @param obj The other object.
308   * @return Whether the two objects are equal or not.
309   */
310  @Override
311  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
312    return obj instanceof Transform3d other
313        && other.m_translation.equals(m_translation)
314        && other.m_rotation.equals(m_rotation);
315  }
316
317  @Override
318  public int hashCode() {
319    return Objects.hash(m_translation, m_rotation);
320  }
321
322  /** Transform3d protobuf for serialization. */
323  public static final Transform3dProto proto = new Transform3dProto();
324
325  /** Transform3d struct for serialization. */
326  public static final Transform3dStruct struct = new Transform3dStruct();
327}
